purpose: Provide durable reusable task identities whose invocation-specific parameters derive exact manifest-bound TT/RTG/GTG constructs and ephemeral runners without creating duplicate permanent implementations or granting execution authority.

tasks.name: README Validation
tasks.purpose: Evaluate every materially changed repository and keep its README accurate for behavior, runtime semantics, interfaces, governance and authority boundaries, evidence semantics, prerequisites, dependencies, failure behavior, and capability meaning.
tasks.trigger: repository materially changed in current work
tasks.reuse_instructions: Run as a completeness predicate. Do not rewrite unaffected documentation and do not treat README prose as execution evidence.

tasks.name: Mirror Handoff Validation
tasks.purpose: Resolve and validate applicable *_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md files for repositories touched by current work and update stale task state, next transition, blockers, dependencies, authority boundaries, terminal evidence, and reusable implementation references.
tasks.trigger: repository or task state materially changed in current work
tasks.scope: applicable handoffs for materially affected repositories/tasks
tasks.reuse_instructions: Treat repository-local handoffs as continuation records, not execution authority. Preserve provenance while correcting current-state projections.

tasks.name: StegIndex Validation
tasks.purpose: Verify that capabilities, repositories, releases, runtime states, interfaces, and governed functions materially changed by current work remain accurately represented in StegIndex and related index projections.
tasks.trigger: indexed capability or indexed source materially changed
tasks.reuse_instructions: Use StegIndex as read/discovery projection. Do not convert index presence into runtime, governance, credential, publication, or execution authority.

tasks.name: Native Email Action Monitor Trigger
tasks.purpose: Trigger the existing STEGVERSE-NATIVE-EMAIL-ACTION-MONITOR-001 through its eligible resident execution path and surface newly actionable items according to its existing authority boundaries.
tasks.trigger: session closeout or explicit reusable-task invocation
tasks.scope: existing native email action monitor only
tasks.reuse_instructions: Reuse the existing monitor and resident dispatcher. Do not create another scheduler, monitor, polling mechanism, heartbeat, worker, or credential route.

tasks.name: Canonical State Reconciliation
tasks.purpose: Reconcile Task Registry intent, WorkerCoordinator claim/fence projections, Master Records observed reality, applicable receipts, mirror handoffs, README completeness determinations, and StegIndex/index state before handoff.
tasks.scope: current task chain and materially affected artifacts
tasks.reuse_instructions: Reconcile rather than overwrite authority domains. Master Records remains observed-reality authority; WorkerCoordinator remains claim/fence authority; InTr remains governed transition boundary.

tasks.name: Session Maintenance Closeout
tasks.purpose: Compose reusable maintenance identities into one bounded session-closeout construct before emitting a compact successor task_id + COSV vector pointer.
tasks.trigger: session has reached its current executable boundary and is preparing handoff
tasks.scope: current task chain and materially affected artifacts only
tasks.reuse_instructions: This is a closeout composition, not a prerequisite that may block an admissible primary runtime transition. Do not recursively audit the ecosystem.

tasks.name: Interlock/InTr Protocol Establishment
tasks.purpose: Resolve or establish the exact governed Interlock/InTr protocol contract required for an internal or external connection without making provider-specific adapter semantics the governance boundary.
tasks.trigger: a task requires a governed connection for which no applicable existing InTr protocol resolves
tasks.reuse_instructions: Check existing protocol surfaces first. Do not create another listener, scheduler, WorkerCoordinator, credential authority, or transition authority.

tasks.name: External Adapter Establishment
tasks.purpose: Derive the endpoint-specific translation layer on the external side of an established Interlock/InTr boundary while preserving normalized StegVerse semantics internally.
tasks.trigger: an external endpoint requires protocol translation not already provided by an existing adapter
tasks.reuse_instructions: The adapter is not the governance boundary and receives no inherited InTr, WorkerCoordinator, or credential authority.

tasks.name: AI Adapter Establishment
tasks.purpose: Specialize the external-adapter identity for an AI/model provider, deriving only provider-specific endpoint, request/response, model, usage, and error translation needed across the existing governed InTr boundary.
tasks.trigger: a governed AI entity/provider requires a provider-specific adapter not already available
tasks.reuse_instructions: Reuse common transport and existing provider adapter components. Never call the adapter working without authentic two-way provider evidence.

tasks.name: External Endpoint Monitor
tasks.purpose: Derive a bounded internal observation task that interacts with an external endpoint only through its existing adapter and governed Interlock/InTr path, recording evidence and deriving adjacent canonical work when a distinct actionable condition appears.
tasks.trigger: an internal capability requires recurring or event-driven observation of an external endpoint
tasks.scope: one endpoint and observation predicate set
tasks.reuse_instructions: Do not create a new scheduler, credential route, listener, WorkerCoordinator, or provider-operation authority. Monitoring evidence does not itself authorize remediation.

tasks.name: Social Platform Interaction
tasks.purpose: Derive a bounded social-platform operation through an existing or derived external adapter and governed Interlock/InTr boundary for publication, reading interactions, moderation, engagement evidence, or follow-up task derivation.
tasks.trigger: StegVerse requires an interaction with a social platform
tasks.scope: one platform identity, operation, and target object set
tasks.reuse_instructions: Platform-specific behavior belongs in the adapter; reusable task semantics, evidence, adjacency, COSV tracking, and governance remain common.
